get.description: Own-account Server-Sent Events stream of invalidation hints (no PII, codes, amounts or text). Frames: `event: ready` data `{}` once subscribed; `event: order` data `{"orderId":"<uuid>"}` when an order the caller is customer or business owner of changes (placed, accepted, preparing, ready, out for delivery, delivered, picked up, cancelled/rejected, code reissued); `event: notification` data `{}` when new in-app notifications were published for the caller; `event: session` data `{"reason":"expired"|"replaced"|"shutdown"}` immediately before the server closes the stream. A `: heartbeat` comment is sent every 25s; `retry: 5000` advises reconnect delay. The session is revalidated every 60s. At most 5 concurrent streams per user (the oldest is closed with reason `replaced`). Delivery is best-effort: refetch REST state on `ready`, on each hint and after reconnect. private, no-store, no-transform; X-Accel-Buffering: no.
